state.question: A negligible-mass satellite follows a Newtonian circular orbit of radius r around mass M. An instantaneous purely tangential impulse reduces its speed to half the circular speed without changing position. Ignore all later perturbations and collisions. What is the periapsis radius of the new Kepler orbit?
state.notation: pi is the circle constant; i is the imaginary unit; ln is natural logarithm; sqrt is the nonnegative square root; c is light speed; hbar is reduced Planck constant. * denotes multiplication and ^ a power.
